about_the_game:
You are being swarmed!

Send the hostile waves of worms back into the void solo (or in 2 player online co-op in Full Game)!

Deceptively simple physics-based core mechanics...

Combine the simplicity of homing auto-attacks with the impact of dash attacks, telekinetic blasts, pebbles and wide pulling areas...

Emerging together into overwhelming combos with superpowers!

Each and every varied level reward superpower choice (many more in Full Game) can combo with core mechanics, spiraling everything out of control... sometimes against you... The superpowers are all very intense and powerful and are meant to be felt through gameplay, without any stats or numbers

And unlockable mutations (1 in the Demo).

Alter how core mechanics behave, combine many mutations together after unlocking each one by winning (2 unlocks in the Demo)...

Everything is a double-edged sword and a mystery to understand through extremely fast-paced action

Be prepared for the consequences and learn from them as you dodge frenzied enemies pinballing all over the map!

Feedback and Bug Reports

This game was built entirely from scratch—without an engine—using procedural, asset-free GPU-side graphics, solo. While we've tested thoroughly and incorporated past feedback, occasional issues may arise. Your bug reports are invaluable! Please report any graphics, sound, networking, or performance issues on Discord or the Steam Forums, and we'll address them as quickly as possible!

Bonus

A swarm simulation mode (4x worm count in Full Game) for when you just want to watch

name: Super Swarmer Survivors Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit fully updated or: 1909 revision .1350+, 2004 revision .789+, 20H2 revision .789+
  • Processor: Dual-Core Intel/AMD CPU
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD DX12, Nvidia DX12 (not Fermi, Shader Model 6.0 required)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Update your GPU drivers if you get "Shader Model 6.0 unsupported" warnings; only tested on Nvidia and AMD GPUs, Intel/Qualcomm might work but untested
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit fully updated
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel/AMD CPU
  • Graphics: Shader Model 6.0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 48kHz stereo

short_description: SSS is a wildly fast-paced solo/duo co-op survivorslite with superkinetic combat, endless mayhem combo potential, unique overpowered non-stat-boost item upgrades and very fast runs. Mutate and slam invasive worms back into the void with telekinetic blasts, void rifts and frenzying hexes!
